appraisal_events.evidence: Je soigne en ce moment une baronne, la baronne Putbus... c'est une femme charmante. Elle connaît du reste Mme Verdurin, je crois. / Et puis il est intéressant, on voit qu'il connaît du monde. Dame, ça sait tant de choses, les médecins !
appraisal_events.explanation: Cottard, still preoccupied with impressing the nobility-minded Forcheville, name-drops a titled patient; Forcheville obligingly completes a favorable judgment of him as worldly and interesting, even as the narrator's deadpan report of Cottard's rambling trivia keeps the effort faintly absurd.

status_effects.explanation: Forcheville explicitly and favorably judges Cottard as interesting and socially connected, a local rise in his standing with the newcomer.
